entityDescription:
Medical University - Plovdiv
The Medical University of Plovdiv (MU-Plovdiv) is a state-accredited institution, founded in 1945, with over 37,700 alumni from 65 countries across Europe, Asia, America, and Africa. As a member of the European University Association, MU-Plovdiv holds the prestigious Erasmus University Charter, allowing participation in EU educational programs. This ensures high-quality education, alongside mobility opportunities for both students and faculty members. The university's educational activities are also certified under ISO 9001:2015.
MU-Plovdiv is comprised of four faculties: Medicine, Dental Medicine, Pharmacy, and Public Health. It also includes a Medical College and a Department of Languages and Specialized Training. The university aligns its curricula with other European institutions, promoting the European Credit Transfer and Accumulation System (ECTS). This system facilitates the mutual recognition of qualifications and encourages student mobility. Clinical training is carried out at six affiliated university hospitals. Since 2007, MU-Plovdiv diplomas have been recognized by all EU and EEA member countries.
The academic staff includes over 200 professors and associate professors, as well as 600 assistant professors. These professionals are known for their significant scientific achievements and extensive teaching experience. Many are active members of international research teams and organizations, contributing to advancements in medical science and education.
Research at MU-Plovdiv is overseen by the Vice-Rector of Science and Research, supported by the Council of Science and Research, as well as other experts and auxiliary units. The university offers nearly 70 doctoral programs spanning medicine, dental medicine, pharmacy, public health, and the natural sciences.
The research community at MU-Plovdiv benefits from advanced research and innovation centers that foster interdisciplinary collaboration. These centers are equipped with cutting-edge technologies, promoting both basic and clinical research, with a strong focus on translating scientific findings into clinical practice. The recently renovated Vivarium provides additional facilities for experimental and preclinical research. Research findings are often disseminated through MU-Plovdiv's academic journal, Folia Medica, which is indexed in Scopus. The university also supports young researchers through the Youth Scientific Association, encouraging their involvement in research projects and scientific events.
MU-Plovdiv's international relations are managed by the International Relations and Foreign Students Department. The university has signed over 150 academic agreements, including Erasmus+ inter-institutional agreements with universities across the EU and beyond. It is also a member of over 15 international academic organizations, offering diverse exchange opportunities through programs such as Erasmus+, CEEPUS, OMI, and Fulbright.
The Department of Medical Physics and Biophysics at MU-Plovdiv upholds the university’s high academic and research standards. The department's research focuses on a variety of experimental animal models, including in vivo, in vitro, and ex vivo studies. Research includes preclinical testing of newly synthesized biologically active molecules, the development of new drug delivery systems, biophysical experiments investigating cell pathways using isolated smooth muscle samples, and cytotoxic studies on primary cell cultures using a real-time cell analyzer. In recent years, the department has embarked on microgravitational studies using rats and mice. To support this research, part of the team developed a modified random positioning machine, suitable for both in vivo and in vitro experiments.

MetaPlanet's aim is to make the vast amount of data about the Earth collected from space available to the general public in an unprecedentedly simple way.

The company's objective is to develop a basic artificial intelligence model for Earth observation that uses time series of high-resolution satellite images to construct a 4D (space and time) representation of the planet with a high level of detail, using techniques such as super-resolution, generative AI and monocular depth estimation.

The AI system consists of two parts: MetaPlanet and AI Analytics. MetaPlanet is a generic AI model and machine representation of the world (different from the usual digital twins), optimised to be queried by other AI agents. An LLM can connect to MetaPlanet. MetaPlanet will thus become an exploitable source of information for all companies and individuals outside the space sector.

BSE was founded to pursue research excellence, it is driven by a world-class faculty and draws on the strengths and reputation of its four academic units. The BSE research community includes Affiliated Professors, Post-docs, Visitors, and PhD students. BSE has obtained three consecutive Severo Ochoa accreditations (2012-15, 2016-19 and 2020-24), which has supported BSE to become one of the leading clusters of economics research in Europe and worldwide.
Barcelona School of Economics is an institution where graduate education and research are closely linked. The core of all BSE educational and research activities are the Affiliated Professors. BSE Affiliated Professors are tenured or tenure-track faculty members from the four academic units (DEE-UPF, UFAE-UAB, IAE-CSIC and CREI). In April 2024, BSE had 152 Affiliated Professors: 122 have a PhD from a non-Spanish university and 78 of them are non-Spanish. Among them 18 are ICREA Research Professors. A total of 42 ERC Grants have been awarded to current BSE Affiliated Professors since the beginning of the program. 10 BSE Affiliated Professors are Econometric Society Fellows. According to RePEc, the reference data repository in Economics, 22 Affiliated Professors are ranked among the top 5% and 50 are ranked among the top 10% of economics researchers worldwide. BSE offers two master degrees in Economics and one master degree in Data Science, besides short courses for professionals. The BSE programs are very international (on average 90% are international students) and are recognized and respected by prestigious universities, companies, and organizations across the globe. On the research side, BSE has since its inception the ambition to be recognized as one of the top institutions in Europe and worldwide for research in Applied Economics, Macroeconomics Microeconomics and Data Science. Quantum Network Design specialised on the design, development but also simulation of quantum networks and their associated protocols in realistic, noisy scenarios. The studied models include noise stemming from gates and storage in NISQ devices alongside noise in channels connecting quantum networking nodes. The simulation engine uses a variety of different computational approaches including efficient classical simulation methods for the study of complex quantum networks running distributed quantum applications in a realistic scenario. These scenarios include not only the noise quantum operations, storages and channels but also all the classical messaging, waiting times and computation times amongst other crucial parameters.
The core competences of Quantum Network Design lie in:
Design, simulation, architecture and protocols for quantum networks

The founders of Quantum Network Design (Wolfgang Dür and Alexander Pirker) have a demonstrated and internationally recognized history in proposing and developing protocols for quantum networks. The protocols include protocols to distribute entangled states within a network, to also combat large-distances amongst nodes but also protocols for generating arbitrary graph states within a network. Furthermore, protocols to achieve reliability have been developed, underlining this competency of Quantum Network Design. Furthermore, Quantum Network Design implements a simulator for quantum networks in a highly configurable manner, allowing operators to change storage and gate noise models but also channel noise models connecting individual nodes. The simulator takes into account for waiting times due to operations, classical messaging but also the dynamic availability of channel and nodes in a network.
Security aspects in quantum networks

Both founders of Quantum Network Design have worked on the security of quantum networks relying on entanglement purification protocols. It was proven that security in a quantum network is always feasible in case the end-nodes have the capability to run entanglement purification protocols, under the assumption of powerful eavesdroppers controlling the entire network. This background is vital to designing a secure DQC network as part of this project.

Exprivia CZ S.r.o. was incorporated as a wholly owned subsidiary of Exprivia S.p.A. (Italy) in the Czech Republic on March 11, 2024. The incorporation process was facilitated with the support of a local consulting firm, Vistra Shelf Companies s.r.o. 
To streamline the process, Vistra proposed the acquisition of an inactive shelf company. As outlined in the share acquisition agreement, Vistra acted as our representative in all actions required for the acquisition of 100% shares in Ivin International s.r.o., located at Nádražní 344/23, Smíchov, 150 00 Praha 5, Id. Nr. 19196644, and registered in the Commercial Register maintained by the Municipal Court in Prague, Section C, Folio 382890 (“Company”). 
The shares were acquired from Vistra Shelf Companies s.r.o., registered in the Commercial Register maintained by the Municipal Court in Prague, Section C, Folio 178238, for a purchase price of 10,000 CZK. Subsequently, Ivin International s.r.o. changed its name to Exprivia CZ S.r.o.
The incorporation of Exprivia CZ S.r.o. reflects Exprivia commitment to providing its international clients with answer to increasingly localized services. Furthermore, it has been crucial for participating in an EUSPA tender. As highlighted in the attached "Extract of Commercial Register," the company is duly constituted with the identification number 191 96 644.

- The local consulting firm is responsible for fulfilling the tax and administrative obligations required by local regulations, even though the company remains inactive at this time

- All strategic decisions are made exclusively by the 100% parent company, Exprivia S.p.A.
